name: Scraptrading
release_notes: Added a Help Centre at /help: 48 step-by-step guides in seven categories, covering buying, selling, auctions, orders, weighment, payments and invoicing for traders, and installation, the scheduler and every settings group for whoever runs the platform. Searchable, readable on a phone, and available as one printable page. Guides are shipped with the code so they stay in step with the screens they describe, and the content is per-locale so translations can be added without a code change.
